description: The Minnesota Death Index record attached to Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) as SD-HOLE-B, carrying the corpus's unambiguous indexing error. It indexes the death as 10 June 1954 against the profile's 10 June 1945 — same day, same month, same county, same name and middle initial, so it is plainly the right man and a transposed digit in the year. The record type matters: a death index date is exact, so this cannot be read as ordinary approximation the way a census age can. That distinction is the point — the 1900 census in this corpus indexes a birth year two years off, which is normal census variance and must NOT be reported as an indexing error. One record with a real transcription error, one with tolerable drift, one genuinely misattributed.
